concept.zh: 并行工位 · 设备依赖 · 排程

brief.zh: 断电后，为维修站安排设备重启。durations[i] 是编号 i 的设备占用一个工位的分钟数，bays 是可并行使用的工位数，两者都是正整数。dependencies 中的 [a, b] 表示 a 完成后 b 才能开始，重复的依赖仍算同一条。编号和时间都从 0 开始。每个时刻先处理同一时刻的全部完工，再按编号从小到大把已经满足依赖的设备安排到空工位。还有可安排的设备时，工位不能空等。重启开始后不能中断。返回 [全部完工的时刻, 按设备编号排列的 [开始, 完工] 列表]。若有设备因依赖相互等待而无法重启，返回 None。没有设备时返回 [0, []]。
brief.en: Schedule the station devices after a power outage. durations[i] gives the minutes device i occupies one bay, and bays is the number of bays that can run in parallel. Both are positive integers. A pair [a, b] in dependencies means device b must wait until device a finishes. Repeating a dependency has no effect. Device IDs and time both start at 0. At each time, process every completion at that time before assigning ready devices to free bays in ascending ID order. A bay cannot sit idle while a device is ready. Each restart runs without interruption. Return [time when all devices finish, list of [start, finish] pairs in device ID order]. Return None if devices are stuck waiting on one another, or [0, []] if there are no devices.
